paragraphs: SHAREHOLDERS AGREEMENT
This Agreement is made on 1 June 2026 between Helios Ventures Private Limited (the "Company") and Kestrel Growth Fund (the "Investor").
1. DEFINITIONS
1.1 "Closing Date" means 1 May 2026.
1.2 "Long-Stop Date" means 1 April 2026.
2. CLOSING
2.1 Closing shall take place on the Closing Date. If the Closing Date has not occurred by the Long-Stop Date this Agreement shall terminate.
3. TERM AND CURE
3.1 This Agreement shall continue for a term of 30 days from the Closing Date.
3.2 A party in breach shall have a cure period of 90 days following written notice.
4. LIABILITY
4.1 The Investor shall have no claim for a Loss below the de minimis of INR 50,000.
4.2 The basket is INR 25,000. The Company shall indemnify the Investor for Loss above that basket.
5. EXPENDITURE
5.1 The Company shall not, without Investor consent, incur any expenditure exceeding INR 10,00,000.
5.2 The Company shall not, without Investor consent, incur any expenditure whatsoever.
6. PRICE
6.1 The Subscription Price is INR 1,00,00,000. The Investor may pay USD 120,000 instead.
7. SURVIVAL
7.1 The warranties shall survive for 6 months after the Closing Date.
7.2 No claim may be brought after the limitation period of 18 months from the Closing Date.
8. EXECUTION
IN WITNESS WHEREOF the parties have executed this Agreement.
For and on behalf of the Company
Name: Authorised Director
